title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-16
source: Set 1: Betty MSR > PCM > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN and Set 2: MSR > Reel > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of an exceptionally hot, exploratory 1973 show that’s perfectly in sync.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about this performance, calling it a smoking, hot, and deeply expressive Dead show from start to finish. The recording is described as crystal clear and well‑balanced, delivering the band’s tight yet loose interplay without any noticeable flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Three consistent 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the recording quality, indicating an outstanding show captured on a high‑fidelity soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as crystal clear, well‑balanced with no reported dropouts or muddiness; the mix captures the band’s dynamics cleanly.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a seamless flow throughout the concert—tight, loose, and exploratory from beginning to end, with no lulls.
